newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Hashimoto expected to visit Australia this month.
newsitem.headline: Hashimoto expected to visit Australia this month.

text.p: Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto is expected to visit Australia at the end of this month, the office of Australian Prime Minister John Howard said on Friday.
Hashimoto's visit on April 28 and 29 is not, however, confirmed, Howard's spokesman said.
Howard went to Japan in September in one of his first overseas visits after becoming prime minister in March 1996.
Japan is Australia's biggest trading partner and Australia is one of the few countries with which Japan has a trade deficit.
